title: Page 211
transc:
1130 AM
From Brookville Sept 10 ' 1215 PM .
For Asia . Your two telegrams of
1030 AM just recd & movement will
be suspended the principal part of
Hooker Command will halt at Unity
the position of Renos Corps will 
not the materially changed a strong
reconnaissance from Renos corps is now
being ordered a good road leads
from New Market intersecting the Ridge
Ville & Damascus road about three
or four miles beyond Damascus
the position at Ridgeville can
be turned by a sufficiently
large force . If Sumners command 
& mine were in position 
at Ridgeville & Damascus I
think we could hold them
against a large force say 
fifty thousand men signed Argyle
